notes.title: Storage Kings is now Salvage Shop Simulator! Demo Live Now!
notes.notes:
[p]Oh boy, how many years has it been? Over 7![/p][p][/p][p]At that time we wanted to create Storage Kings, but lack of budget caused the project to be put on hold.[/p][p]But this year it returns with double force as Salvage Shop Simulator:[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3555500/Salvage_Shop_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]The game concept has been expanded, there will be more features related to store management, like the real Storage King does.
[/p][p]We have just launched the alpha demo version of the game to gather feedback and ideas.[/p][previewyoutube="zEKiTIxKUpA;full"][/previewyoutube][p]In this vertical slice, you'll:[/p][list][*][p]Join your first [b]container auction[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Search through salvaged items and [b]bid against NPCs[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Clean and appraise[/b] what you win[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sell items[/b] in your shop and set your own prices[/p][/*][*][p]Learn the [b]core gameplay loop[/b] of acquiring, trading and growing your business![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Try your hand at bidding![/p][p]Cheers[/p]
